newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland seizes largest ever cocaine haul.
newsitem.headline: Ireland seizes largest ever cocaine haul.

text.p: Irish police said on Monday they had seized the largest cocaine haul in the history of the state over the weekend.
The drugs, with a street value of up to $130 million, were found in a converted Norwegian trawler, they added.
Heavy gales had forced the ship, the Sea Mist, to deviate from its route between Venezuela and northern Europe and shelter in a port in Cork, southern Ireland, where the haul was found.
Four people are being held under new legislation which allows suspected drug-traffickers to be detained for up to seven days without charge.
It was the second major drugs find in Ireland in a matter of weeks. Forty kilos of cocaine were confiscated in the western port of Moneypoint, last month, valued at $51 million.
